name: A3

tenures.source: The card's own commentary and script name Carson the leader, Manson and Cantina the members, 'the only face member of A3,' and The Rumbler 'down with A3'; Deathstroke is named as absent and is not minted.

caption: A stable led by Cody Carson that splits at Blood Is Thicker Than Water, where Manson beats Cantina for the Continental title and Carson beats Mike Young for the World title.

name: The Enterprise

tenures.source: The card's own announcer introduces Guardian 'accompanied to the ring by The Enterprise' as Mr. Mike and Simon Sensation walk out with him; Mike OxBig later says Wilkins 'has fought off practically the entire Enterprise.'

caption: A group of Hell's Guardian, Mr. Mike and Simon Sensation that walks to the ring together at Blood Is Thicker Than Water.
